CLIP (with atom IDs): E06.040 | 01:22.00-01:26.00 | CAM | Medium two-shot of Selene and Tobin, the space between them charged.
E06.041 | 01:22.40-01:25.80 | DLG | MARA (broken, tender) | "If I say yes, the harbour keeps its tongue."
E06.042 | 01:24.50-01:26.00 | SFX | A heartbeat pulse rises toward the cliffhanger.
E06.043 | 01:26.00-01:30.00 | CAM | Tight shot on a silver ring glinting in candlelight.
E06.044 | 01:26.20-01:30.00 | ACT | the widow kneels on the slick quay boards.
E06.045 | 01:26.40-01:29.44 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (cold, triumphant) | "Order! I will have order in my hall!"
E06.046 | 01:30.00-01:36.00 | CAM | Slow push-in on Corin as the lamp flickers behind them.
E06.047 | 01:30.40-01:33.44 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (nervous, cold) | "Take the girl to the cells until morning."
E06.048 | 01:36.00-01:42.00 | CAM | Extreme close-up on Corin's eyes, wet with sea spray.
E06.049 | 01:36.40-01:39.44 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (triumphant, nervous) | "Order! I will have order in my hall!"
E06.050 | 01:42.00-01:46.00 | CAM | Wide shot of the storm-lashed harbour, lanterns swinging on the quay.
E06.051 | 01:42.40-01:45.44 | DLG | MARA (quiet, tender) | "I kept that light burning for eleven winters."
E06.052 | 01:46.00-01:50.00 | CAM | Close-up on the widow's hands gripping the rail.
E06.053 | 01:46.40-01:49.44 | DLG | CORIN (cold, calm) | "Nobody leaves this hall until I say so."
E06.054 | 01:50.00-01:55.00 | CAM | Slow push-in on the Mayor as the lamp flickers behind them.
E06.055 | 01:50.40-01:51.92 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (O.S., cold, furious) | "Drink deep, little lamp-keeper."
E06.056 | 01:55.00-01:58.00 | CAM | Close-up on Mara's hands gripping the rail.
E06.057 | 01:55.40-01:57.80 | DLG | TOBIN THE FERRYMAN (urgent, gruff) | "They are coming up the cliff path with lanterns!"
KEY REVEALS OF THE SHOW: R01 (E1): [mock] Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her
R02 (E2): [mock] The harbourmaster is revealed as Lord Corin Ashvale, thought drowned, and offers Mara a bargain
R03 (E3): [mock] On the wedding morning a poisoned cup forces Corin to choose between justice and Mara's family
R04 (E4): [mock] Selene spreads a rumour that Mara lit a false light to wreck a ship
R05 (E5): [mock] Tobin the ferryman reveals what he saw on the night of the feast
R06 (E6): [mock] The council votes to take the lighthouse from Mara
R07 (E7): [mock] Corin's past returns on a ship flying a black pennant
R08 (E8): [mock] Mara discovers her father's logbook hidden in the lamp room
